fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for a bug request. Finding: in the built-in plan and plan-milestone workflows (internal/workflow/builtin/plan.toml, plan-milestone.toml), review always passes to critic, but rhiza run verdict (internal/api/run_review.go) refuses an empty verdicts list, so after a clean round (seen in run 01M77N1ENKEAY668AM2STW90V7, round 2) the critic can record nothing and cannot meet its prompt. The code review workflow's checks step already gives a clean round no critic (decision critics-on-serious-findings). One question was raised: skip the critic on a clean round, let run verdict accept an empty list, or both. With no owner, the arbiter decided plan-clean-round-skips-critic: route a clean round from review straight to fresh, and keep run verdict refusing an empty list. The change set serves m4-runs-hold-up, as the earlier fix review-visit-records-round did. One leaf was planned on plan-workflow.
fields.title: Plan of the fix: plan workflows send a clean review round to the critic
